name: sol_integrations_chainlink_ccip_1
description: CCIP receiver missing source chain/sender allowlist validation
question: The source file in `source` defines a `_ccipReceive` (or equivalent CCIP receiver callback) function that processes an incoming `Any2EVMMessage` without validating its `sourceChainSelector` and decoded `sender` address against an administratively controlled allowlist, allowing messages from unauthorized chains or senders to be accepted and processed, excluding cases where such checks are performed elsewhere (e.g., in a base contract or modifier actually enforced on this function) or where the function is intentionally open to any sender/chain by documented design.
criteria: _ccipReceive decodes any2EvmMessage.data and executes logic without checking any2EvmMessage.sourceChainSelector against a whitelist
_ccipReceive extracts sender via abi.decode(any2EvmMessage.sender) and uses it directly without comparing it to an allowed sender mapping or address
ccipReceive/_ccipReceive processes token or message payloads and triggers state changes or external calls with no allowlist check on sourceChainSelector or sender
Receiver callback trusts any2EvmMessage.sender as the message origin for authorization decisions without verifying it against a stored trusted sender list
